content:
Priya Desai: heads up — noticed ~10% of PR eval runs are missing shards this morning, artifacts not uploaded so downstream reporters fail
Alberto Kim: ugh. seen 401s in uploader logs?
Priya Desai: yes: `POST /_apis/artifactupload 401` right after runners spin up. repro on selfhosted and gha hosted pools
Danielle (Dan) Park: could be token scope drift when GH scales runners and the `GITHUB_TOKEN` transient expiry hits during long eval shards
Priya Desai: makes sense. we saw similar once with nightly matrix and long-running uploads
gha-bot: workflow run 11234: eval-matrix (partial) -> failed artifact upload (401)
Alberto Kim: quickfix: add explicit `permissions: contents: write` to workflow and bump upload-action to v3. also ensure `id-token: write` if we call OIDC
Priya Desai: posting minimal diff: ```yaml
permissions:
  contents: write
  id-token: write
jobs:
  eval-smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: shard-artifacts
          path: ./artifacts/shard-*
```
Danielle (Dan) Park: that will help but root cause is token refresh during runner warmup. long-term we should move uploads to a short-lived sidecar that retries with a service account token from our secrets (KMS-protected)
Priya Desai: agreed. short-term I can land the perms change + bump action. can someone add a smoke eval gate on PRs (1 shard, quick checks) so we fail fast before heavy matrix starts
Alberto Kim: I'll add a new job `pr-smoke-eval` in the GH workflow with matrix=1 and `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'`
Danielle (Dan) Park: and schedule a nightly backfill job in Buildkite to re-run any PRs that had missing artifacts yesterday — buildkite-bot can emit rerun list
buildkite-bot: scheduled pipeline `eval-nightly-backfill` -> queued
Priya Desai: awesome. after perms + smoke gate we should monitor a week and then ship the sidecar retryer
Alberto Kim: I'll open a tiny PR and link here
Priya Desai: thanks — assigning to @Alberto for the GH changes, @Dan for buildkite cron. tagging infra to watch runner autoscale during deploy :eyes:
Danielle (Dan) Park: noted. I'll add extra logging around token refresh window (30m->45m) and alert if uploads hit >0.5% 401s
Priya Desai: perfect. if anyone hits it in the meantime `gh run rerun --all` works as a manual unblock :thumbsup:
Alberto Kim: PR  + changelog posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/842
Priya Desai: closing loop — will check tomorrow morning and post metrics. thanks team :tada:
